subject: Fix UNUSED repetition issue in test sources (#475)
reason: The change only adds an #ifndef guard around the UNUSED macro in src/unit/test_help.h and removes two #undef UNUSED lines in unit test files (test_kvstore.c, test_util.c). It affects compilation of the unit test harness only, not the valkey-server binary, any command, replication, persistence, or tools. There is no runtime behaviour to reach, so no scenario is needed.
